name: Ingram
title: Charter Dike-master
examine: Born on the Amber where the river is a working thing. Under canvas at the crofts' gate, where the dike begins. He walks the line at the ford each morning with a level in his hand.
lines: Water goes where it is let. I am not letting it go across the road any more. Where it goes instead is a fair question with a fair answer: not across the road.
The Company broke the sluice. A wet road is a paying road and a dry one is not. You do not need a level to read that.
The crofts pay because the ford voted that the crofts pay. I wrote twice. I build what is voted. Ask the moot who should have paid; they will say the crofts.
I pay the man at the bar and I call him a thief, and both of those are Charter policy. A wain does not fight at a bar.
